newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreign buying boosts early morning Tokyo stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign buying boosts early morning Tokyo stocks.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose early on Monday as participants were encouraged by gains in recent sessions and foreign investor buying, they said.
As of 0014 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 39.03 points, or 0.21 percent, at 18,761.03. Benchmark March futures were up 110 points at 18,830.

"Although participants are worried about profit taking by domestic institutional investors ahead of March 31 book closings, sentiment remains basically firm," an official at one of Japan"s "Big Four" brokerages said.
